subject: Re: QBR follow-up — install fee for a second team, and re-engagement terms
latest_external_message_body: Hi Nadia — thanks again for the QBR. The eight reps on the wholesale desk are approving drafts daily now. Nobody has asked for a new login, which is the part my ops lead did not believe. Before I take the store-team rollout upstairs I need two things in writing. First, what the install fee covers for a second team and what it does not. Second, how re-engagement is priced when we change the way we sell next season — Aaron in procurement will ask for the year-two number, and I want to be able to say zero rent and mean it. Can you send the pricing and packaging guide so I can attach it, and then we lock a terms call? — Renata

subject: Who approves the draft? — after Wade's readout
latest_external_message_body: Hi Nadia — following Wade's readout, one question keeps coming back at me internally. When the agent drafts the follow-up after a site visit, who approves it, and what stops it sending on its own while a group booking is still being negotiated? Our sellers work across the casino floor, the hotel desk and events, so a draft that goes out uninvited is a real problem here. Wade also said the readout itself was not recorded — could you send whatever notes you have from that session so I can brief the events team? — Lina
